messages.subject: Problem with scale_x_date()
parts:
When I run the example code from the scale_x_date() page on the ggplot2 website, I get "Error: Invalid input: date_trans works with objects of class Date only"

Here's what my R terminal looks like.

> # We'll start by creating some nonsense data with dates
> df <- data.frame(
+   date = seq(Sys.Date(), len=100, by="1 day")[sample(100, 50)],
+   price = runif(50)
+ )
> df <- df[order(df$date), ]
> dt <- qplot(date, price, data=df, geom="line") + theme_bw()
> 
> # We can control the format of the labels, and the frequency of
> # the major and minor tickmarks.  See ?format.Date and ?seq.Date
> # for more details.
> library(scales) # to access breaks/formatting functions
> dt + scale_x_date()
Error: Invalid input: date_trans works with objects of class Date only

Any idea what could be going on here? Would rolling back any of my package versions solve this problem? I think everything is up-to-date.
